description: Parsing the output of a privileged batch (several elevated steps run as one script behind one password/UAC prompt). After each step the script prints one marker line: '@@cleanup-step-<nonce> <index> <exitCode> <step output as base64 of its UTF-8 bytes>' (the base64 field is empty when the step printed nothing, leaving a trailing space). The output is split into lines on '\n' and '\r' (so CRLF and bare CR both work). A line counts only if it starts with '@@cleanup-step-<nonce> ' for this batch's nonce, then has 2 or 3 space-separated fields, an integer index, an integer exit code and (if present) valid base64; anything else is ignored. Markers count only in step order: a marker counts only when its index equals the number of markers already accepted, so a stray, repeated, out-of-order or forged line cannot claim a step. A step with no accepted marker reports exitCode -1 and empty output (never ran: script killed or prompt refused). Decoded output is trimmed of leading/trailing whitespace and newlines. Each case: nonce, stepCount, the raw output text, and the expected result per step in order.

cases.name: maps markers to steps and decodes their output
a step without a marker reports -1 (not run)
wrong nonce, unknown index, garbage and a repeated index are ignored
a marker arriving before its turn is ignored
CRLF and bare CR line endings do not hide markers
invalid base64 makes the marker invalid
no output at all: every step reports -1
